fact: The Global Fund OIG audit of December 2024 states that the malaria grant expanded DHIS2 coverage with tablet-based real-time data, that the INASA-run DHIS2 holds national programme data, and that malaria data completeness of health facilities was 45% in the June 2023 progress update.
title: GF-OIG-24-021 Audit of Global Fund grants in Guinea-Bissau
publisher: Global Fund Office of the Inspector General
